items.title_orig: My goal for the year was to listen to 365 albums, and I hit the goal a few days ago, so I wanted to share some thoughts
items.article_text:
the first thing I wanted to put in is a list of what I thought were 10/10 albums, they’re not in any specific order
  
Dark Side of the Moon - Pink Floyd
 The Final Cut - Pink Floyd
 Star Wars: A New Hope soundtrack - John Williams
 The Greatest Showman Soundtrack
 …And Justice For All - Metallica
 Abbey Road - The Beatles
 The Sunset Tree - The Mountain Goats
 What’s Going On - Marvin Gaye
 To Pimp a Butterfly - Kendrick Lamar
 Dookie - Green Day
 Madvillainy - MF Doom
 Buena Vista Social Club - Buena Vista Social Club
 My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy - Kanye West
 Off The Wall - Michael Jackson
 Plastic Ono Band - John Lennon
 Graduation - Kanye West
 Viva La Vida - Coldplay
 Minecraft Alpha Soundtrack - C418
 Ten - Pearl Jam
 Season of Glass - Yoko Ono
 Interstellar Soundtrack - Hans

items.title_orig: OfficialAment and AmesBros are bringing Since Forever to Paris!
items.article_text:
Post oficial de @pearljam no Instagram (IMAGE), 2026-10-14T17:02:19+0000.

Legenda original:
OfficialAment and AmesBros are bringing Since Forever to Paris!

Join the Ament Brothers on November 15 at legrandrex for a conversation about their new book and the stories behind the photos, moderated by Charlotte Blum. Afterwards, settle in for a special screening of montanagrind, directed by danreis and with an original soundtrack by Jeff.

Get tickets at the link in bio.
